3532-4842-5078-8346.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4881-5929-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-5929-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

147-6929-8095.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-4385-6441.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating two creature tokens due to Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic land
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3099-4762-5902-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
3099-4762-5902-7803.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Brad Boimler and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3209-6441.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {4}{G}, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying at most {3} and tapping two creature tokens, creating two creature tokens and returning Sprout Swarm from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two tapped creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Repeat from step 2.
2034-3209-6441.notes: The starting cost can be reduced by tapping creatures to pay for Sprout Swarm using its convoke ability, and/or sacrificing those creatures to Ashnod's Altar.

240-3967-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2511-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7325.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and that has base toughness 2 or greater.
5147-6972-7325.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1251-3259-4373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

930-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

562-3835-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Sage of the Beyond.
Repeat.

1017-2428-6980.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-2428-6980.description:
Draw a card.
Horizon Chimera and Wizard Class trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Wizard Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
1017-2428-6980.notes: With the additional Wizard Class trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat.

411-2440-4720.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
When Grinning Ignus enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Repeat.

2292-2523-5558.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Enraged Huorn.
When Enraged Huorn dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Enraged Huorn that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Enraged Huorn token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Enraged Huorn token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2523-5401-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bilbo.
When Bilbo dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bilbo that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Bilbo token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Bilbo token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1692-2829-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-2829-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-2829-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

204-3716-5851.manaNeeded: {10}{R}{R} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-3716-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-3716-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {3}{R}{R} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing X damage to any target, and returning Fanning the Flames to your hand.
Repeat.
204-3716-5851.notes: The combo involves casting Fanning the Flames with X=0 to reduce the amount of mana needed. Once you have spare mana, you may increase the amount of mana used to cast Fanning the Flames to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Walking Ballista from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

49-1799-4242-5256.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
49-1799-4242-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2544-3094-3263-4176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
2544-3094-3263-4176.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Karn triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Karn's ability.
Resolve the copy of Karn's ability, adding {C} for each artifact you control that cannot be spent to cast nonartifact spells.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {3}, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2906-3689-3698.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least three life this turn.
1020-2906-3689-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Retriever.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

2743-4285-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {3}{R}{R}, copying Quasiduplicate twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Quasiduplicates, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

173-1491-2221-2625.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling attached to Kibo.
Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
173-1491-2221-2625.description:
Activate Kibo's original ability by tapping them, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
Activate your Banana by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/G} and gaining 2 life.
Martyr's Bond triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice an artifact they control and/or activate their own Banana in response.
Kibo triggers for each artifact an opponent controls that was put into a graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter onto each Ape or Monkey you control that many times.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Sinking Feeling by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Kibo, untapping them.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Screaming Shield's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Kibo.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Screaming Shield by paying {2} and tapping them, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Kibo using the ability granted by Sinking Feeling by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on Kibo, untapping them.
Repeat the previous two steps any number of times.

914-2034-3719.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2034-3719.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure token, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
